messages.content: You are a precise information extraction system. You only output valid JSON.

Extract entities and events from the document below.

Entity types: Person, Organization, Location, Building, Product, Art, Other

Event types and their argument roles:
- Attack: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Consequence
- Military_operation: roles = Agent, Patient, Location
- Conquering: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Name
- Killing: roles = Killer, Victim, Location, Cause, Instrument
- Death: roles = Agent, Cause, Location, Instrument
- Bodily_harm: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Cause
- Catastrophe: roles = Patient, Location, Loss, Content
- Destroying: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Loss
- Damaging: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Loss
- Statement: roles = Speaker, Message, Location, Details
- Change_of_leadership: roles = New_leader, Old_leader, Location, Selector, New_Occupation, Old_Occupation
- Arriving: roles = Agent, Location

Rules:
1. Copy every entity mention, trigger and argument exactly as it appears in the document.
2. List every entity mention (including repeated mentions of the same entity).
3. Create one event entry for every trigger occurrence of the event types above. Ignore other kinds of events.
4. Arguments may appear anywhere in the document, not only in the trigger's sentence. Omit roles with no argument.

Return a JSON object in exactly this format:
{
  "entities": [
    {
      "text": "<entity mention copied from the text>",
      "type": "<entity type>"
    }
  ],
  "events": [
    {
      "trigger": "<word or short phrase in the text that signals the event>",
      "type": "<event type>",
      "arguments": {
        "<role>": [
          "<argument span copied from the text>"
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}

Document:
The 2007 Greek forest fires were a series of massive forest fires that broke out in several areas across Greece throughout the summer of 2007 . The most destructive and lethal infernos broke out on 23 August , expanded rapidly and raged out of control until 27 August , until they were put out in early September . The fires mainly affected western and southern Peloponnese as well as southern Euboea . The death toll in August alone stood at 67 people . In total 84 people lost their lives because of the fires , including several fire fighters . Some of these firestorms are believed to be the result of arson while others were merely the result of negligence . Hot temperatures , including three consecutive heat waves of over 40 °C ( 105 °F ) , and severe drought rendered the 2007 summer unprecedented in modern Greek history . From the end of June to early September , over 3,000 forest fires were recorded across the nation . Nine more people were killed in blazes in June and July . A total of 2,700 square kilometers ( 670,000 acres ) of forest , olive groves and farmland were destroyed in the fires , which was the worst fire season on record in the past 50 years . Of the total of 2,700 km² , 1,500 km² ( 370,000 acres ) were burnt forests in Southern Greece alone . Many buildings were also destroyed in the blaze . The fire destroyed 1,000 houses and 1,100 other buildings , and damaged hundreds more .
